book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Yesu teyoxe xel en zeimeing mema

Bouk ti eno Yesu la di zeimema nanghei danghei ti. Gyeik ingwei zeimema woy, eno e xe xel betiyeing ti neil wou e bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, teyoxe xa en zeimeing mema, nambei Yoan mi teyoxe e xe xel betiyeing o.”
Moxo neil wou xel, “Gyeik ingwei xam ambei zeimemamim eno xam a neil ambei nye:

content.text: wa leim e mi mendei vambuing,
Wa mi bong xa mi lul yaeing wou xa e teyei lek bouk titi.
Me wa semaleeng sewokeing wei xa yo,
en xa is ambei nyon xa mi semaleeng sewokeing wei xel sapa wong wou xa yo.
Me wa seng bong xa na eivek axeing.’”

content: Woyom moxo neil wou xel, “Wangwei xam on ti xe gweleeng ti, me e la wou moxo eivek boukeing masenghoing me neil wou, ‘Gweleeng, wang bong belet yayal wou ay,
en nambei a xe gweleeng ti mi tupwou sakwaing me lam wou ay, ekom lul yaeing wei ambei bong wou e eno ma.’
“Woyom tambiy tiwei toundei lalei eno lewexe bei, ‘Wa seng bo pok wou ay. En xomek mya a xey woy, me yakyak di yeip is a lek zek. A se teyeimbei qandi lek me na bong lulul ti wou wang.’

A neil wou xam, moxo tyek se qandi lek me bong belet wou e en nambei inyei e xe gweleeng o, qe en ingwei toungale nikanzek wou e yo, moxo tyek qandi me bong lulul wou e teyei lek ingwei e lalei vind o.
“Om a neil wou xam: Xam teling on tyek bong wou xam, xam ghe gwimexe on tyek xam ghe gweiwou, xam ghe nyeis memamim lek qapomb on tyek natax en xam.
En xel sapa wei mi teling en vatiyeiw eno xel mi qou, xel eti yeiw wei mi yimexe eno mi yeiwou, me eti yeiw wei mi leis memend lek qapomb eno mi tax.
“Xam mayeiyeiw on, eti wangwei neum embei teling wang en woing ti, tyek wang bong myeiy wou e?
O wangwei e teling en neughalus ti, tyek wang bong boklevek wou e?

Nambei nyon xam wei sewokeing on, ekom xam ghe mi woulek lul nimza wei xam a being bong wou neumyeiw o. Yond xam ghe boulek bei xam Mamim wei toundei eivek tyoung gheyapu nei tyek bong Laweeng Vambuing wou xel wei mi teling e yo.”
Yesu me Belsebul
Yesu tiy memo wei myatu yo veil tambiy ti. Gyeik ingwei memo la veil eno tambiy wei myatu eno luk, om moux alis vex ngenong yei me etek.
Ekom xel on valu neil embei, “En nikanzek wei Belsebul, gyovaxa wei memo, eno e mi tiy memo nangya.”
Xel valu axe moxo me neil, “Wang bong dee wei lulvako yo ti en xa boulek bei Anutu wong wang lam.”
Yesu yei woueing nalei wei xel o me neil wou xel, “Tete lalei wei eti yeiw dembuma me wong vevek wou emaxow eno tyek bo nol, me wangwei xomek ti dembuma me bong vevek wouma eno tyek detei eivek.
Wangwei Sandang xe xel dembuma me bong vevek wouma, on tyek e xe tete lalei bale nikanzek ambei nya? A neil tine en nambei xam ghe neimbei a tiy memo nangya Belsebul.

Ekom wangwei a tiy memo na veil angya Belsebul nikanzek nei, ond eti mi vind xel wei xam o me xel mi tiy memo yon la myayaing? Om xel wei xam eno tyek talex wou xam bei qayeeng wei xam on se la wo bombek.
Ekom wangwei a tiy memo nangya Anutu mema deyis, on Anutu xe tete lalei lam wou xam.
“Wangwei moux wei nikanzek o ti bale zeyi beeng is lulul wei vevek o, on tyek e xe lulul a toumendei embo nimza.
Ekom wangwei xelti nikanzek ghanaw e veil, on tyek na bo vevek wou e me bou lul vevek wei di qou nikanzek eivek o veil e, de dembu e ning lulul wou xel ba.
“Xel eti yeiw wei se mindei is ay eno mi wo vevek wou ay, me eti yeiw wei se mi qeku moux alis vex wou is ay, eno mi tiy xel lala.”
Laweeng nilaxes loumelam no

“Gyeik ingwei laweeng nilaxes ti lam myayaing veil moux ti, on tyek na ghavineeng eivek tembuing wei memiing ma veil o. Me gyei beyeeng wei embei na qou laweeng o, ek se gyeiwou ti. Woyom tyek na neil, ‘Tyek a nox me na eivek xomek wei a lam veil o.’
Gyeik ingwei loum tei eno yei xomek xel pepa e wo vako me menyex wou.
Woyom la qou laweeng amba lim yuw wei xel ghanaw e veil en kwa nol o, me xel la dei eivek xomek lalei tiyon. Om deing wei tambiy tiyon eno wo nol ghanaw ingwei tax o.”
Sakwaing wei xomaxoneing bo xeindlala yo
Ka Yesu di neil ti beimambei ne, eno vex wei toundei eivek qekueing ama yon ti taxe la wou e, “Vex tiwei wou wang me wo luul wou wang eno e mi bo xeilala.”
Moxo byex e mya leit bei, “Embong ondek xey a neimbei xel wei mi ngo Anutu xe xoulek me betiwou eno na mi bo xeindlala.”
Dee wei Yona yo

Ka moux alis vex ngenong di lam me nyouk, om Yesu neil, “Xomaxoneing wei gweimbeeng ne nilul ayang. Xel teling en embei gyei dee wei lulvako yo, ekom tyek xel se gyei ti, qe tyek xel gyei lulvako wei Yona yo.
En Yona wong ambei dee wou Niniweyeiw, om nambei nyon is, Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek bong ambei dee wou xomaxoneing wei gweimbeeng ne.

“De kwin wei xonei eno tyek qandi lek bouk wei wongeing qayeeng me bo qayeeng en xomaxoneing wei gweimbeeng ne me na neil xel xe nilul teyei, en lam anghei tembuing myasepu en embei ngo Salomo xe lupeyei, me gweimbeeng ne tambiy ti ghanaw Salomo eno toundei inye.

Lek bouk wei ngoeing qayeeng eno xel wei Niniwe tyek qandi me bale me bo qayeeng en xomaxoneing wei gweimbeeng ne me na neil xel xe nilul teyei, en xel pekwi xow gyeik ingwei Yona la neil xoulek o. Wei, gweimbeeng ne tambiy ti ghanaw Yona veil eno lam toundei inye.
Lam wei neing o
“Xelti se mi byex eivek lam me toung eivek beyeeng wei embei bund xeiyaing o, o toung eivek deng lalei. Qe xel mi toung leklam vaxa gheyapu, om xel wei la lalei eno mi yei xeiyaing.

Wa mamghalus on lam wei wa neing o. Wangwei wa mamghalus luw xouing a toumendei embo nimza, on tyek wa neing dalus na pup en xeiyaing. Ekom wangwei luw xouing bo nol on tyek wa neing na pup en mapetok ngandoung.
Om wang gweiteyei, en xeiyaing wei toundei eivek wang on se bo mapetok.
Nambei nyon wangwei wa neing dalus on na pup en xeiyaing, me boukeing e ma veil wa neing danghei ti, on wa neing dalus wo xeiyaing, nambei ingwei xeiyaing wei lam mi byex lek wang o.”
Kwa nilul wei xel Parisi me putoung wei petieing o
Gyeik ingwei Yesu neil xoulek ma yo, Parisi ti teling bei e na gya is e, om moxo eivek la lalei me la yeip pepeeng lek zek me ya.
Ekom Parisi yei ingwei Yesu se lipek atax ekom ya, om di wounalei ngenong.
Woyom Tambiy Ngandoung neil wou e, “Xam Parisi ghe mi sekweyexe mayamya luw dipek demi, ekom xam laleimim on pup en kwa eivekeing me nilul.
Xam xomaxoneing on bandol! Beip tambiy tiwei betiy lulul on demi eno se betiy lalei is?
Ekom xam ghe bong vati wei toundei eivek dipek lalei eno wou xel wei kanyo yo, on tyek xam ghe bo vako yang wou Anutu manghalus.

“Xam Parisi ghe gwaleeng amim en nimaying, en xam ghe mi wong ti eivek xoumeeng xoing senyeing me lulul eivek xuk wei xam o, ekom xam ghe saing kwa wei bombek me kwa wei lalei vineing Anutu yo, om xam betiwou kwa ti beimambei yon de xam ghe bong luw xouing bo nimza.

“Xam Parisi ghe gwaleeng amim en nimaying, en nambei xam laleimim mi vind sia nimza wei xomek qekueing ama yo, me xam ambei xel a mi neil bendiyeing teiv wou xam eivek beyeeng wei xel mi wo vateivek lek lulul o.
“Xam ghe gwaleeng amim en nimaying, en xam ghe xok leiveeng meyeing xupekeing wei xomaxoneing qeilek en xel se woulek.”
Xel wei lupeyei ngandoung en petieing wei Mose yo ti neil wou Yesu, “Putoung, gyeik wang neil qayeeng ambei nyon, eno wang neil xa is.”

Yesu byex e vya leit bei, “Xam wei lumimpeyei ngandoung en petieing wei Mose eno xam ghe gwaleeng amim en nimaying, en nambei xam ghe mi qou lul nimaying me ghe toung lek xomaxoneing me xel mi wo pok lek qaleing, dom xam memamim ti se mi vind xel.”
“Xam ghe gwaleeng amim en nimaying, en nambei xam ghe mi ev leiveeng meyeing wei xel poropet, wei bumyeiw leis xel mey o.
Om xam ghe talex lek bei xam ghe lenghek lek vati wei bumyeiw wong o, xel leis xel poropet mey, de xam ghe kwelexe xel xe eeng wei meyeing o.
“En nambei tiyon, om eivek Anutu xe lupeyei nimza eno neil, ‘Tyek a bong xel poropet me sinaleyeiw wou xel, tyek xel nyeis xel valu mey de bo nol wou xel valu.’
Nambei nyon xam xomaxoneing wei gweimbeeng ne tyek na qou myaveweeng lek gyand wei xel poropet, wei xel leis gyeik bouk wei Anutu toung tembuing o,
nanghei Abel gyand me e mi la Sakalias gyand, tiwei xel leis e mey eivek qeind aluw xomek vambuing senghoing o. Ee, a neil wou xam, xomaxoneing wei gweimbeeng ne tyek na qou myaveweeng tiyon dalus.

“Xam wei lumimpeyei ngandoung en petieing wei Mose yo ghe gwaleeng amim en nimaying. En xam ghe zeim ki wei qoueing lupeyei nimza yo veil. Xam venaxow seng la eivek, de xam ghe nale zeyi xel wei embei na eivek o.”
Gyeik ingwei Yesu la veil inyon, eno xel Parisi me xel putoung wei petieing o laleind wo nol wou e, om xel nale zeyi e nangya teling wei nikanzek o.
Xel di axe e en embei bo qayeeng en e, en ingwei e neil qayeeng ti na sewok o.
